name: rapp
description: RAPP apps for AI assistants: build agents, find agents, and get verified world numbers.

plugins.name: rapp-agent-builder
plugins.description: Turn any idea or meeting transcript into a working single-file AI agent, check it, and use it right away.

plugins.name: rar-agent-finder
plugins.description: Find a free, ready-made AI agent for a task in the public RAPP Agent Registry (about 1,700 agents).

plugins.name: dogg-world-check
plugins.description: Verified, citable numbers about the world right now, each with a public tick and SHA-256 fingerprint.

plugins.name: rapp-domains
plugins.description: Check and price domain names, and learn how to register them.

plugins.name: rapp-name-finder
plugins.description: Name a business or project and check free domains and GitHub names.
